title: The Test of Jerusalem

segments.text: They thought they finally had him. He claimed he had traveled, in one night, to a city a month's ride away... a city they knew, and he had never lived in. So they demanded he describe it. And he described it... looking at something they could not see.
This is the test... of Jerusalem.
segments.title: THE TEST

segments.text: Here is what he described. The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, was taken by Allah from Makkah to Bayt al-Maqdis... the holy sanctuary in Jerusalem... and from there raised through the heavens. Muslims call it the Night Journey. A round trip the caravans measured in two months, he said, had happened while his city slept.
segments._shot: Cover photo reused as a still (Ken Burns) on the Bayt al-Maqdis / Jerusalem beat - literal + never freezes (owner request 2026-07-11)

segments.text: But here was their opening. Makkah's caravans had ridden north into Sham... greater Syria... for generations, and some of those merchants had seen Jerusalem with their own eyes. They knew its shape. If this man had never been there... the details would break him.
segments._shot: REDO: ancient stone fortress wall at dusk (Pexels 29497654)

segments.text: He described it himself. Standing in al-Hijr, the open courtyard beside the Ka'bah at the heart of Makkah, he said... when Quraysh, his own tribe, did not believe me... Allah displayed Jerusalem in front of me. And I began describing it to them... while I was looking at it.
segments._shot: REDO: Islamic mosque dome+minarets gold on black (Pexels 6010701)

segments.text: The same account stands in Sahih Muslim. Allah lifted before me Bayt al-Maqdis... and I narrated its signs... while I was looking at it. Sign after sign... detail after detail... from a man staring past them at something only he could see.
segments._shot: dark room, one window of brilliant light

segments.text: The examiners chose the test. The examiners knew the answers. And the record of what happened next is not that the details failed... it is that the description held.
segments._shot: REDO: dark ancient stone vaulted archway (Pexels 37617037)

segments.text: Fourteen centuries later, the two cities are still standing... still joined by that one night. He passed their test. The question the story leaves behind... is yours.
segments._shot: REDO: minaret silhouette + crescent moon at dusk (Pexels 18953366)
